about_the_game:
Step into the golden age of archaeological discovery in the 1920s as an ambitious archaeologist racing to uncover the secrets of ancient Egypt. DigSite invites players to dig, explore, clean, document, and donate long-forgotten relics hidden beneath the vast desert sands.

Buy a dig site license, choose the right spot and dig for valuable artifacts. The intense desert heat and endless sands will take their toll, and your survival depends on balancing your physical needs. Drink water regularly to avoid dehydration, as the oppressive sun and physical labor will quickly drain your energy. Find shaded spots where you can rest in the heat of the day.

When you contribute a rare artifact to the museum, the rewards are significant. You’ll earn substantial recognition and monetary compensation. This funding can be used to expand your excavation operations.

After cleaning and restoring the finds, it’s time to document your discoveries. Use a vintage camera to take photos, capturing every angle of the artifact before it is sent off to a museum. Your images, detailed notes, and thorough cataloging will not only preserve the artifact for future generations but will also help you build a reputation as one of the greatest archaeologists of your time.

As darkness falls, the temperature drops sharply, and the once scorching sands now feel cold and treacherous. With limited visibility, you’ll need to use a lantern to find your way back to your tent and rest for the night. The day-night cycle is critical to your journey, as certain actions and explorations can only be carried out during daylight. The desert at night is treacherous - creatures like snakes and scorpions lurk, waiting to strike.

Features:

  • When you dig an artifact the work is not done. You need to clean it and identify it with help of the professor and document it with a camera.

  • During digging you need to manage your stamina by resting in a shadow or drinking water.

  • As you dig or when you wander at night you can encounter local fauna such as snakes and scorpions which you better avoid.

  • Sometimes weather is not good for digging, you can encounter sandstorm.

  • There are puzzles to be solved which can reveal unique artifacts.

  • Choose between top-down view or first-person view.

  • Artifacts are randomly placed so each play-through is different.

  • If you have little money you can earn some by taking photo of tourists or giving old books to the professor.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: 2.6 GHz Quad Core or similar
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 950 or Radeon HD 7970
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: DigSite is archeology sandbox game located in Egypt where you dig, clean and document artifacts you find. Donate rare artifacts to a museum and build your legacy as a legendary archaeologist.
